integrity: Analytic all-order proof plus a reproducible 95-check finite cross-check, not a machine certification of all real parameters.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion bounds the total of scalar real multiplicities off a finite resonance set. It identifies the entire nonisolated zero locus at resonances, not the number of other isolated zeros at every gap. Priority relative to unindexed literature is unconfirmed. No independent validation.
title: Sharp finite-zero ceiling and exact resonance lines for two-tone Hermite spectrograms
